title: UPSSSC Exam Calendar 2026
organization: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission
vacancyDetails: Tentative schedule of UPSSSC examinations planned in 2026 including PET-linked and direct recruitments
howToApply:
1. Visit https://upsssc.gov.in
2. Open Important Links / Notifications
3. Download UPSSSC Exam Calendar 2026 PDF
4. Note tentative months for your exams
5. Follow live advertisements for exact dates and PET requirements
shortDescription: UPSSSC Exam Calendar 2026 out with tentative exam schedule. Download from upsssc.gov.in.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the Exam Calendar 2026.

The calendar lists tentative examination timelines for various group posts under UPSSSC. Many recruitments also depend on PET scores and live advertisements for final dates.

Tips

  • Download the official calendar PDF
  • Track OTR / PET status if required for your post
  • Do not treat calendar months as final until advt. is live
